layout.house_prompt: A master bedroom with a king-size bed, an attached walk-in closet, and a master bathroom. A desk is positioned in one corner of the room for working, there is a laptop on the right side of the desk and a wallet on the left side. There are also two sofa chairs next to the window. There is a sink mounted in the bathroom with a soap on the left side.

hallway.text_description: A modern minimalist entry hallway/vestibule providing access to the master suite; simple clean lines, neutral palette.

bathroom.text_description: A modern minimalist master bathroom attached to the bedroom with a wall-mounted sink/vanity; place soap on the left side of the sink.

closet.text_description: A modern minimalist attached walk-in closet for the master bedroom with hanging rails and shelving (walk-in closet connected to the bedroom).

bedroom.text_description: A modern minimalist master bedroom with a king-size bed, an attached work desk positioned in one corner for working with a laptop on the right side of the desk and a wallet on the left side, plus two sofa chairs placed next to the window.
